description: This file defines the Cryptographer class which provides encryption and decryption functionalities using the phpseclib3 cryptography library. It handles symmetric encryption with AES and Rijndael algorithms, allowing secure data transformation within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Cryptographer
classes.description: Provides methods to encrypt and decrypt data using AES and Rijndael algorithms with a fixed key length and block size.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cryptographer with a secret key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a given string value using Rijndael and returns the encrypted data in uppercase hex format.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted hex string back to the original plaintext using AES.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates an encryption key based on the provided secret key, using XOR with a zeroed string.
